title: For each instance that has a completed migration, show the instance display
question: For each instance that has a completed migration, show the instance display name, availability zone, migration status, migration type, instance UUID, and the dense rank of migrations within each instance UUID, along with the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of non-deleted system metadata entries per instance for that same display name. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH completed_migrations AS (
  SELECT
    i.display_name,
    i.availability_zone,
    m.status AS migration_status,
    m.migration_type,
    i.uuid AS instance_uuid,
    m.id AS migration_id
  FROM migrations m
  JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid
  WHERE m.status = 'completed'
),
ranked_migrations AS (
  SELECT
    cm.display_name,
    cm.availability_zone,
    cm.migration_status,
    cm.migration_type,
    cm.instance_uuid,
    cm.migration_id,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cm.instance_uuid ORDER BY cm.migration_id) AS migration_dense_rank
  FROM completed_migrations cm
),
non_deleted_metadata_counts AS (
  SELECT
    i.display_name,
    i.uuid AS instance_uuid,
    COUNT(ism.id) AS non_deleted_system_metadata_count
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE ism.deleted = 0
  GROUP BY i.display_name, i.uuid
),
display_name_metadata_stats AS (
  SELECT
    display_name,
    MAX(non_deleted_system_metadata_count) - MIN(non_deleted_system_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range,
    VARIANCE(non_deleted_system_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_variance,
    STDDEV(non_deleted_system_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_stddev
  FROM non_deleted_metadata_counts
  GROUP BY display_name
)
SELECT
  rm.display_name,
  rm.availability_zone,
  rm.migration_status,
  rm.migration_type,
  rm.instance_uuid,
  rm.migration_dense_rank,
  dns.metadata_count_range,
  dns.metadata_count_variance,
  dns.metadata_count_stddev
FROM ranked_migrations rm
JOIN display_name_metadata_stats dns ON dns.display_name = rm.display_name
ORDER BY rm.instance_uuid, rm.migration_id;

    m.id AS migration_id

    MAX(non_deleted_system_metadata_count) - MIN(non_deleted_system_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range,

)

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, m.id
  FROM migrations m
  JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid
  WHERE m.status = 'completed'
),
meta AS (
  SELECT i.display_name, i.uuid, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM instance_system_metadata s
  JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = s.instance_uuid
  WHERE s.deleted = 0
  GROUP BY i.display_name, i.uuid
),
stats AS (
  SELECT display_name,
         MAX(cnt) - MIN(cnt) AS range_val,
         VARIANCE(cnt) AS var_val,
         STDDEV(cnt) AS std_val
  FROM meta
  GROUP BY display_name
)
SELECT b.display_name,
       b.availability_zone,
       b.status,
       b.migration_type,
       b.uuid,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY b.uuid ORDER BY b.id) AS dense_rank,
       st.range_val,
       st.var_val,
       st.std_val
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN stats st ON st.display_name = b.display_name
ORDER BY b.uuid, b.id;
